purpose: Reposition/preserve without illegal teleport/min-range behavior or constant windup cancellation

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Reposition/preserve without illegal teleport/min-range behavior or constant windup cancellation
setup: A valuable damaged ranged/support actor has legal escape room and covering friendlies
Resolve any actual heal ability and weapon minimum range from definitions
actions: Attack the valuable actor through ordinary combat
Observe reposition, protected attacks and healing only if the runtime capability exists
measurements: Native health, windup start/cancel/impact, movement route, weapon range and actual heal effects
required: Actor preservation uses legal positioning and useful completed attacks/effects

forbidden: Teleportation, firing inside illegal range or imaginary healing
Survival with no continuing useful action when a safe shot exists
branches: Safe firing position versus exposed one
